description: This file contains utility functions related to file selection and directory path retrieval, specifically designed for a Flutter application. It provides a class 'FileUtils' with methods to pick files from the device and to obtain the application documents directory path.

classes.name: FileUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to interact with files on the device, including picking files and retrieving the app documents directory path.

methods.name: pickFiles
methods.description: Prompts the user to select one or multiple files and returns a list of their file paths. Returns an empty list if no files are selected.

methods.name: getAppDocsDirPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the application's documents directory.
